title: Integral representation of time-harmonic solutions to Maxwell's equations with fast numerical convergence
summary: The robustness of XRD methods for the determination of the lattice parameters of crystals is well established. These methods have been extended to helical atomic structures using twisted x-rays \cite{friesecke_twisted_2016}. Building on an integral form used in \cite{friesecke_twisted_2016}, we construct integral representations of a broad class of time-harmonic solutions to Maxwell's equations in a vacuum or, more generally, in a homogeneous medium without source terms.
